title: 찜 목록
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop City Pop track featuring a smooth male tenor vocal. The arrangement centers on a clean, funky electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note rhythms and a slap bass that follows the kick drum pattern. A bright acoustic piano provides rhythmic chord stabs on the off-beats. The drums feature a crisp snare and a steady eighth-note hi-hat pattern. Subtle analog synth pads provide harmonic fill in the background. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
